title: T48: honest reads, early Teams refusal, search-first recap, plain titles (0.7.30)
head: t48-honest-behavior
body:
**needs Braden** — the ask-first gate's injection suite now treats `outlook.recent_mail` as a read, so it no longer needs a Yes card (see Mutation check).

## Summary

T48, agent-core 0.7.30: honest reads, an early Teams refusal, a search-first recap, and plain chat titles (TICKETS T48 items 1–4, 6–8; the desktop half, items 5 and 8 display, waits until T31 leaves desktop-app).

- **Reads by message time (#215, #217, #218):** "new since" is decided by each message's time, not the chat listing's order. Last-read times per chat persist in the drawer. Every read result carries `complete: true|false`. A read stops at 10 s and returns what it has with `complete: false`. When a read is incomplete, the reply says it may be partial and never says "no new messages".
- **Teams refusal up front:** the first Teams-aimed reply says "I can draft it, but I can't send Teams messages yet; want it as an email?" before any drafting.
- **Search-first recap:** "give me a recap" runs mail, Teams and calendar reads, then answers, with no menu questions.
- **Mail summaries lead with the last 24 h;** unread counts never lead (#214).
- **Chat titles:** 2–4 plain words naming the subject (`title_ok` refuses act-words). A one-time retitle migration runs with a done marker. Chats saved before `auto_titled` existed count as auto-titled, so the migration reaches them. A title the person chose (a rename, or an explicit title at create) is never retitled.
- **Dependencies:** connectors 0.5.2 wheel vendored (built from connectors 3079cd6, sha256 3b0953ab…, provenance in vendor/PROVENANCE.md); `outlook.recent_mail` is a read.
- Version 0.7.30 and CHANGELOG.

## Mutation check

16 mutants, **16 killed**, 0 survived (`swarm mutants`, target test files: test_t48_replies, test_t48_reads, test_chat_store, test_chat_tools, test_injection_suite, test_chat_pending_text, test_chat_endpoints):

- Reads: read_marks_merge_direction_flipped, incomplete_note_condition_inverted, complete_false_note_dropped, incomplete_read_lead_wording_changed, daily_summary_recent_mail_no_longer_leads, leading_unread_count_regex_never_matches, runtime_guard_connectors_version_reverted.
- Replies: teams_send_unavailable_text_reverts_to_old_wording, recap_pattern_never_matches_bare_recap.
- Titles: act_words_drops_greeting, title_ok_allows_one_word_titles, legacy_default_false, migration_ignores_marker, migration_retitles_renamed.
- Gate: recent_mail_catalog_action_wrong_capability; **recent_mail_classed_write** (make recent_mail a write) is killed by `test_recent_mail_is_a_read_never_a_write_needing_a_card`. The injection suite drops exactly one pair, `("outlook", "recent_mail")`, from the harness's WRITES; every other connector write still requires a card Yes.

Model-input rule (#73): no change to what goes in system instructions. Summaries and tool text still travel as their own labelled messages.
